composition_strategy: Central-focal composition with an emphasis on horizontal flow, balanced with left-heavy mass distribution to maintain visual interest.
focal_strategy: Focal point placed in the lower right to attract attention and guide the viewer's eye across the scene.
depth_strategy: Layered depth to create a sense of space and dimension, allowing the eye to travel through different planes.
border_or_perimeter_strategy: Open perimeter to give a sense of expansiveness and unobstructed views, encouraging exploration of the scene.
title_safe_region_strategy: Title area positioned in the upper left to provide contrast and calm visual balance.
programme_safe_region_strategy: Programme area placed in the upper right, ensuring it does not compete with the focal point.
